verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs describe extensive delegation features—Copilot in Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook, Researcher, Analyst, Browse with Copilot performing multi-step browser actions, and Cowork handling 'bigger, multi-step tasks'—clearly positioning Copilot as a built-in assistant that can take on tasks. However, hands-on community reports contradict smooth delegation in practice (e.g., Copilot in Word 'couldn't do anything except append to the end of the document,' couldn't create tables or maintain formatting, and some users report never finding a real use case), indicating real-world task execution is often shallow or unreliable. Missing for 10: independent verification of successful complex multi-step task completion, and resolution of documented editing/execution failures in flagship apps.
